caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between shared sub-dimension ratios and evaluation perplexity (PPL) for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims” and has a linear scale ranging from 0/4 to 4/4, with tick labels at each whole number ratio (0/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” and has a linear scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A blue solid line with triangle markers displays the data for the MoHD model, starting at approximately 10.9 at 0/4, decreasing to 10.4 at 1/4, continuing to 10.2 at 2/4, increasing to 10.6 at 3/4, and ending at 10.8 at 4/4. A dashed orange line represents the Transformer model, remaining roughly constant across the x-axis, starting at 11.6 at 0/4 and finishing at 11.5 at 4/4.
